name: Ring the Bell!
summary: A missable Chapter 1 optional encounter with Cal at The Rusty Anchor that unlocks a Rusty Anchor T-shirt and cap.
body: IGN lists Ring the Bell! as a Chapter 1 optional mission, started by answering a text from Cal asking for drinks while Jason is on his way to meet Brian at the marina.
IGN says it is played at The Rusty Anchor in Key Lento and can only be done in Chapter 1; IGN's Chapter 1 missables page lists it as missable.
IGN says the mission offers shots that blur the screen and loosen the controls if all three are taken, and that the reward depends on agreeing to drive Cal home.
IGN says doing so lets the White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt and Rusty Anchor Cap be bought at The Rusty Anchor afterwards; they cannot be bought without it.

facts.location: The Rusty Anchor, Key Lento, Mariana County
facts.reward: White Rusty Anchor T-Shirt and Rusty Anchor Cap become buyable

name: Got Pills?
summary: A short Chapter 2 main mission at the Starlet Motel, played as Lucia, that IGN lists with no reward.
body: IGN lists Got Pills? as a short Chapter 2 main mission played as Lucia around the Starlet Motel, with the starting objective Find Painkillers and no reward.
IGN says it runs from room to room in the motel and ends at Vicki's door in Room 10, where knocking starts the next main mission, Girls' Trip.
IGN notes that stray cats at the Starlet Motel can be studied for the Animals collection and petted for a Focus buff.
